relations.text: SAPとAlibaba Groupが戦略的提携の拡大を発表した(5月27日)
relations.text_en: SAP and Alibaba Group announced an extension of their strategic partnership on May 27

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On May 27, SAP and Alibaba Group announced an extension of their strategic partnership to accelerate cloud transformation.

relations.text: SAPのクラウド製品4種を、中国企業向けにAlibaba Cloudで段階的に提供する計画を、SAPとAlibabaが発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Alibaba announced the phased launch of four SAP cloud solutions on Alibaba Cloud for Chinese enterprises

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - Also on September 24, SAP and Alibaba announced plans to advance their strategic partnership with the phased launch of four SAP cloud solutions (SAP Cloud ERP, SAP Cloud ERP Private, SAP BTP, and SAP Integrated Business Planning) on Alibaba Cloud for Chinese enterprises in China.

relations.text: MongoDBは、Alibaba Cloudなどと組み、中国で認定MongoDB-as-a-Serviceを提供している
relations.text_en: MongoDB offers an authorized MongoDB-as-a-Service solution in China with Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud

source.label: MongoDB 10-K
source.quote: We have expanded our global partner ecosystem with Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud to offer an authorized MongoDB-as-a-Service solution in China, allowing their customers to easily adopt and consume our hosted solution.
source.note: MongoDBの文書による記載です。

companies.name: ソフトバンクグループ

relations.text: Alipayの持分と支配権を手放した後、2011年7月にSoftBankおよびAltaba Inc.と基本契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: After the divestment of Alipay, the company entered into a framework agreement in July 2011 with SoftBank and Altaba Inc.

source.label: Alibaba 20-F
source.quote: After the divestment of our interest in and control over Alipay, we entered into a framework agreement in July 2011, or the 2011 framework agreement, with SoftBank, Altaba Inc.

relations.text: Alibaba CloudとHPが、中国でのAI PCの拡大に向けた協業の拡大を発表した
relations.text_en: Alibaba Cloud and HP announced an expanded collaboration to accelerate the growth of AI PCs in China

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: Alibaba Cloud, the digital technology and intelligence backbone of Alibaba Group, and HP, have announced an expanded collaboration to accelerate the growth of AI PCs in China.

relations.text: AlibabaのQwen(30億パラメータ)を、HPのスマートアシスタントに組み込む
relations.text_en: Alibaba's Qwen model (3 billion parameters) will be integrated into HP's smart assistant

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: As part of the partnership, Alibaba’s open-source large language model, Qwen (with 3 billion parameters), will be integrated into HP’s smart assistant

relations.text: 車載コックピット向けのQwenベースのマルチモーダルモデルを、QualcommおよびBanmaと共同で開発した
relations.text_en: Alibaba developed its Qwen-powered automotive cockpit multimodal model in collaboration with Qualcomm and Banma

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: Alibaba has unveiled its latest large multimodal model (LMM) solution powered by Qwen and specifically designed for automotive intelligent cockpits, developed in collaboration with global semiconductor leader Qualcomm and Banma, its intelligent cockpit solution provider.

relations.text: Alibaba CloudのPAIが、NVIDIAのPhysical AIソフトウェア群の全体を統合すると発表した
relations.text_en: Alibaba Cloud's Platform for AI (PAI) announced an integration of the full suite of the NVIDIA Physical AI software stack

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: Alibaba Cloud’s Platform for AI (PAI) announced an integration of the full suite of the NVIDIA Physical AI software stack,

relations.text: 自動車向けのマルチモーダルモデルを、NVIDIAおよびBanmaと共同開発した
relations.text_en: Alibaba Cloud's automotive multimodal model was co-developed with NVIDIA and Banma

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: Alibaba Cloud today unveiled its large multimodal model (LMM) solution designed for automotive applications and co-developed with NVIDIA and Banma

companies.name: パロアルトネットワークス

relations.text: Palo Alto NetworksがAlibaba Cloudとの技術提携を発表した
relations.text_en: Palo Alto Networks announced a technology partnership with Alibaba Cloud

source.label: Palo Alto Networks ブログ
source.quote: Today we announced our technology partnership with Alibaba Cloud at the Computing Conference 2018, hosted by Alibaba Cloud in Hangzhou, China.

relations.text: Signifyが、AlibabaのQwenを使った生成AIエージェントを公開した
relations.text_en: Signify launched a GenAI agent powered by Alibaba's Qwen model

source.label: Alibaba Cloud の発表
source.quote: Signify, the world leader in lighting , has launched the industry's first GenAI agent powered by Alibaba's self-developed large language model Qwen.

relations.text: BYDなどの中国の自動車メーカーが、Qwenを車載システムに統合すると発表した
relations.text_en: BYD is among Chinese automakers that announced the integration of Qwen into their intelligent vehicle systems

source.label: Alibaba Cloud community post
source.quote: On the opening day of the 2026 Beijing Auto Show (April 24), leading Chinese automakers – including BYD, Geely, Li Auto, Changan Automobile, Dongfeng Motor, BAIC (Beijing Automotive Industry Holding Co., Ltd.), Great Wall Motor, SAIC Volkswagen, SAIC IM Motors – announced the integration of Qwen into their intelligent vehicle systems.
source.note: Alibaba Cloudの公式ブログの記載です。
source.note_en: Per Alibaba Cloud's official community post.

relations.text: リ・オートなどの中国の自動車メーカーが、Qwenを車載システムに統合すると発表した
relations.text_en: Li Auto is among Chinese automakers that announced the integration of Qwen into their intelligent vehicle systems

source.label: Alibaba Cloud community post
source.quote: On the opening day of the 2026 Beijing Auto Show (April 24), leading Chinese automakers – including BYD, Geely, Li Auto, Changan Automobile, Dongfeng Motor, BAIC (Beijing Automotive Industry Holding Co., Ltd.), Great Wall Motor, SAIC Volkswagen, SAIC IM Motors – announced the integration of Qwen into their intelligent vehicle systems.
